scope: Original default/copy key constructors, locale/type equality, actual SharedObject references and UnifiedCache protocol. Concrete application key/value classes implement the original abstract extension interfaces in the compiled caller. Their factories allocate real SharedObject-derived values and return actual owned hard references; the original library and production Calendar factory are unchanged. No private field/counter or source algorithm is substituted. Native physical allocator/threading and whole application ABI parity are not claimed.
